title: Condensed Matter Physics
content: Condensed matter physics explores the emergent properties of many-body systems in solid and liquid phases, where collective interactions yield unique quantum phenomena. Charting crystal lattices, electronic band structures, superconductivity, and topological insulators, this curriculum maps the macroscopic manifestation of quantum mechanics in structured matter.
intro: Welcome to the Condensed Matter Physics gateway. This roadmap connects the foundational principles of the field to its modern mathematical frontiers.

pillars.title: 1. Crystal Lattices & Phonon Dynamics
pillars.narrative: The geometry of periodic structures and the quantization of their mechanical vibrations.

pillars.title: 2. Electronic Band Structure
pillars.narrative: How the periodic potential of a lattice dictates the behavior of electrons, leading to the distinction between metals, insulators, and semiconductors.

pillars.title: 3. Magnetism & Collective Ordering
pillars.narrative: The emergence of macroscopic magnetic ordering from microscopic exchange interactions and spin dynamics.

pillars.title: 4. Superconductivity & Superfluidity
pillars.narrative: The breakdown of electrical resistance and fluid viscosity through the formation of macroscopic quantum condensates.

pillars.title: 5. Topological Phases & Modern Frontiers
pillars.narrative: The classification of phases beyond spontaneous symmetry breaking, governed by global topological invariants.

pillars.title: 6. Electronic Transport & Correlated Matter
pillars.narrative: Semiclassical metallic transport, disorder-induced wave localization, strongly correlated Mott insulators, Landau quasiparticles, and magnetic impurity screening.

pillars.title: 7. Critical Phenomena, Quantum Matter & Soft Condensed Matter
pillars.narrative: Symmetry-breaking order parameters, renormalization-group universality, zero-temperature quantum criticality, Bloch-band Berry curvature spintronics, and soft-matter liquid-crystal elasticity.

pillars.title: 8. 2D Quantum Materials, Spintronics & Topological Matter
pillars.narrative: Massless Dirac fermions in graphene, magic-angle moiré flat bands, chiral magnetic skyrmions, 3D Weyl semimetals and the chiral anomaly, and fractional quantum Hall composite fermions.

pillars.title: 9. Semiconductor Devices, Photonics & Quantum Hardware
pillars.narrative: Semiconductor p-n junction depletion physics and the Shockley diode equation, MOSFET band bending and two-dimensional electron gases, photovoltaics and light-emitting diodes governed by the Shockley-Queisser limit, superconducting SQUIDs and transmon quantum circuits, and X-ray, electron, and neutron diffraction probes of condensed matter.
